title: The GrowHub Joins Project We Care Seminar
summary: The GrowHub attended the Project We Care Seminar to collaborate with other companies on supporting the community.
body_markdown: What an awesome event held at the ArtScience Museum last night![The GrowHub Innovations Company](https://www.linkedin.com/company/thegrowhub/) spoke alongside speakers from[DBS Bank](https://www.linkedin.com/company/dbs-bank/) and ICP Hub Singapore, covering different topics in the digital space. A big "Thank You" to[Digital Assets Association (DAA)](https://www.linkedin.com/company/digitalassetsassociation/) for having us.
